description: This file implements the Administrator class within the Thunder::RPC namespace, managing IPC channels, proxies, stubs, and interface references for RPC communication. It includes methods for reference counting, proxy management, validation, and cleanup of IPC resources.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC communication, proxies, stubs, and interface references within the Thunder RPC framework.

methods.name: Administrator::~Administrator
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up proxies and stubs.

methods.name: Administrator::Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of Administrator.

methods.name: Administrator::AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for an interface implementation.

methods.name: Administrator::Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for an interface implementation.

methods.name: Administrator::Release (overload)
methods.description: Completes a proxy call with a response.

methods.name: Administrator::UnregisterUnknownProxy
methods.description: Unregisters a proxy from the internal maps.

methods.name: Administrator::Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method on an interface based on message parameters.

methods.name: Administrator::IsValid
methods.description: Validates if an instance is valid for a given channel and interface.

methods.name: Administrator::ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy for a given channel, instance, and interface.

methods.name: Administrator::ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given channel and interface.

methods.name: Administrator::RegisterUnknown
methods.description: Registers a new interface implementation for a channel.

methods.name: Administrator::UnregisterUnknown
methods.description: Unregisters an interface implementation from a channel.

methods.name: Administrator::Convert
methods.description: Converts raw implementation pointer to IUnknown based on stub id.

methods.name: Administrator::DeleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a channel and cleans up associated proxies and references.
